component.name: org.nuxeo.ecm.core.event.raise.DocumentEventRaiserService
component.documentation: Central service responsible for raising document modification events (e.g. DOCUMENT_UPDATED, DOCUMENT_BLOB_MODIFIED) through pluggable DocumentEventRaiser contributions. Each raiser is bound to an event name; when a raise is requested the service dispatches to the raiser that supports that event.

extension-point.name: raisers
extension-point.documentation: Contribute a DocumentEventRaiser implementation bound to an event name.
